preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each thread connects two distinct nodes u and v, where u and v are integers between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 + 6 for u, v, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each thread's clamminess x is an integer between 1 and 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {0, 1} for u, v, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each thread's color c is either 0 (red) or 1 (black).
The cobweb is a tree with exactly n-1 threads (edges).

postconditions.description: The output is the jelliness of the cobweb modulo 10^9 + 7, where jelliness is the product of the clamminess products of all valid paths between unique node pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v in unique_pairs)
postconditions.description: The jelliness considers all unique unordered pairs of nodes (u, v) where u < v.

postconditions.expression: all(any(abs(red_count - black_count) <= 2 for red_count, black_count in path_stats) for path_stats in path_counts)
postconditions.description: For each pair of nodes (u, v), only the shortest paths where the absolute difference between the number of red and black threads is at most 2 are considered.

postconditions.expression: all(len(paths) >= 1 for paths in shortest_paths) or jelliness == 1
postconditions.description: If there are no valid paths for any pair, the jelliness is 1. Otherwise, the jelliness is the product of the clamminess products of all valid paths.

postconditions.expression: all(path_product == 1 if not valid_paths else path_product == product(x for u, v, x, c in path_edges) for path_product, valid_paths, path_edges in zip(path_products, valid_path_flags, path_edges_list))
postconditions.description: For each valid path, the product of clamminess values is computed as the product of x for all edges in the path.
